hooks.command: FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("file_path",""))' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.py$' && ! echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '(/\.venv/|/tests?/|_test\.py)'; then OUT=$(ruff check "$FILE" --quiet 2>&1 | head -10); [ -n "$OUT" ] && printf '⚠️ ruff su %s:\n%s\n' "$FILE" "$OUT"; fi; exit 0

CMD=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("command",""))' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'push[^|]*(--force|-f )[^|]*\b(main|master)\b|\b(main|master)\b[^|]*(--force|-f )'; then echo 'BLOCKED: force-push su main/master vietato (standard ~/Progetti/CLAUDE.md)'; exit 2; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -q -- '--no-verify'; then echo 'BLOCKED: --no-verify vietato (standard ~/Progetti/CLAUDE.md)'; exit 2; fi; exit 0
